retrospective-phase-analysis CLI (v0.1.0)

Usage:
  node scripts/retro-cli.mjs <command> [options]
  node scripts/retro-cli.mjs help [command]
  node scripts/retro-cli.mjs --help
  node scripts/retro-cli.mjs --version

Commands:
  scan           Build a JSON summary from a session trace and stage logs.
  report         Generate a Markdown retrospective draft.
  skill-audit    Generate a skill-focused Markdown draft.
  logging-review Generate a logging-quality and improvement draft.

Notes:
  Generated reports are drafts; validate them against the cited artifacts.
  Commands write output files and stay quiet on stdout unless help or version is requested.
